topic: Topographic, electrical, plumbing and structural drawings

questions.q: 99. Topographic drawing is drawn to show
questions.explain: Topographic maps depict both natural features (rivers, hills, vegetation) and man-made/artificial features (roads, buildings, bridges) of an area.

questions.q: 100. In topographic map, the symbol used to represent mosque is
questions.explain: A crescent shape is the standardized conventional symbol used on topographic maps to indicate the location of a mosque.

questions.q: 101. In topographic map, the symbol used to represent church is
questions.explain: A cross symbol is the standard conventional sign used on topographic maps to mark the location of a church.

questions.q: 102. In topographic map, the symbol used to represent tree is
questions.explain: Trees are generally represented by a small, irregular circular or clustered symbol to distinguish them from man-made point features.

questions.q: 103. In topographic map, the symbol used to represent stone is
questions.explain: A single stone or boundary marker is often represented by a small dot symbol on detailed survey maps.

questions.q: 104. In topographic map, the symbol used to represent school is
questions.explain: Educational institutions like schools are conventionally marked with the letter 'S' enclosed in a small box or circle on topographic maps.

questions.q: 107. Topographic map is drawn to represent
questions.explain: Topographic maps are generally used to depict natural and cultural details spanning a large geographical area.

questions.q: 152. Topographical maps are drawn to a :
questions.explain: Since topographic maps need to show significant detail (contours, symbols) over a wide area, they are typically drawn to a large scale (e.g., 1:25000) to maintain clarity.

questions.q: 178. Structural drawing shall furnish complete information for :
options: fabrication and erection of structural elements
questions.explain: Structural drawings must contain all necessary specifications, dimensions, and material grades required for engineers to safely fabricate and erect the load-bearing components of a building.
